title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on a cold stone floor, head pounding. You are locked inside an old library. Dust hangs in the lamplight. You can make out a desk, a bookshelf, a painting, a small locked drawer and a heavy door with a four-digit keypad. Look closely at everything, collect useful items, solve the puzzles and find the code that opens the door.

descriptions.text: A heavy oak desk, bare now except for a dried inkwell.
A heavy oak desk covered in dust and ink stains. Under a dried inkwell lies an old letter.
Rows of dusty books line the shelves. Four red books on the middle shelf stick out at different depths from all the others.
Inside the front cover of each red book is a handwritten digit. From left to right they read: 3, 7, 1 and 5.
The storm-tossed lighthouse painting. The hidden panel in its frame now stands open and empty.
A storm-tossed lighthouse in oil paint. A brass plaque reads: Plate 42. In the lower edge of the frame there is a tiny keyhole.
The drawer hangs open. It is empty now.
The drawer is open. A small silver key lies inside.
A small drawer set into the desk, secured by a four-digit dial lock.
A heavy oak door with a four-digit keypad. The display blinks LOCKED.

old_letter.name: old letter
old_letter.description: The faded ink reads: 'The books remember what I forgot. When you find the key, remember the painting watches over what is hidden. The way out is the plate first, then what the frame hides.'

silver_key.name: silver key
silver_key.description: A small, ornate silver key, cold to the touch.

drawer_digits.text: The four red books carry the digits 3, 7, 1 and 5, left to right.

door_second_half.text: A slip of paper hidden behind the painting's frame bears the number 86.

drawer.success_text: The dial clicks into place and the drawer slides open. A small silver key lies inside.
drawer.wrong_text: The dial lock rattles but the drawer stays shut. That is not the right code.

door.success_text: The keypad chirps, the bolts retract and the heavy door swings open. Cool night air rushes in. You have escaped the library!
door.wrong_text: The keypad gives an angry buzz and the display flashes ERROR. That is not the right code.

uses.missing_text: You have not found anywhere to use the key on the painting yet.
uses.text: The silver key fits the tiny keyhole in the frame and turns with a click. A hidden panel swings open, revealing a slip of paper bearing the number 86.
uses.already_text: The hidden panel in the frame is already open.

hints.text: Some objects look more interesting than others. Try examining the bookshelf.
Look closely at the books that are out of place. The locked drawer wants four digits.
The painting is worth a careful look.
The drawer holds something that might fit a small keyhole.
The door's code is built from what the painting shows and what its frame hides.
